## Design rationale visible in code

- **Derived numbers are never saved.** Caps, rates and similar values are rebuilt from today's content on every load, so a rebalance reaches old saves (`src/persistence.ts:147-150`, `src/persistence.ts:235`). [HIGH]
- **Pacing is measured by playing the engine.** Nothing is estimated by hand (`scripts/validate.ts:270`). [HIGH]
- **One parser** serves validation and live play, so a gate that validates is a gate that runs (`scripts/validate.ts:58`). [HIGH]
- **Single-tab ownership** through Web Locks removes save races (`src/main.ts:159-161`). [HIGH]
